objective: Give each image/prompt variant bounded Azure-response retries while preserving successful variants and shared rate limits.
attemptBudget: Four total lifetime attempts per job: initial submission plus up to three retries; preserve historical attempt rows and numbering.
eligibleResponses: Unclassified HTTP 400 and HTTP 408/409/429/5xx from Azure; never retry explicit authentication, permission, invalid-parameter or content-policy rejections.
uncertainTransport: No definitive HTTP response, cancellation, timeout/connection loss and recovered in-flight requests remain protected from replay.
existingFailures: An explicit CLI option reconsiders only eligible failed variants, with exact source-version validation, current request identity adoption, immutable prior-failure/transition audit and transactional state guards. Never reset successful variants or the whole queue.
scheduling: Exponential backoff, provider retry hints, shared completion-based 2-RPM pacing and cancellation remain intact.
compatibility: Opt-in expanded policy; defaults remain conservative. No database migration, no source renaming, no new dependencies.
config: Enable opted-in Azure-response retry policy and four total attempts in active interactive config; preserve current prompt texts and all other settings.
workflow: Development and build only. Tests, reviews, QA and final judgment paused by CTO.
liveExecution: Not authorized or performed by this development task; no automatic actual-image submission.
